notes: Section-listing pagination. robots.txt (User-agent: *, Crawl-delay 5) only disallows /recherche and a few auth paths, so article listings are open to us. Routes rejected: /sitemap.xml is a flat urlset of 429 SECTION fronts only (no article URLs); /sitemap-news.xml holds just the last two days (35 URLs, all 2026-10-24); per-day sitemap guesses (/sitemap-2026-10-20.xml, /sitemap_*.xml, /sitemap/2026-10-20.xml, /sitemap/articles.xml) all 404; no /wp-json (not WordPress). Route used: https://www.ledevoir.com/<section>?page=N server-rendered, 20 cards/page, each card carries <time datetime="...Z"> (UTC) plus /<section>/[<sub>]/<id>/<slug>. Walked the 8 news sections (actualites, politique, economie, monde, culture, opinion, plaisirs, sports); 43 subsections added nothing new (subsets of the parents, deduped). Dates taken from the card <time>; verified against article:published_time on 6 samples (exact match every time). Result: 1590 unique URLs, every day 2026-09-25..2026-10-24 covered, min 16/day (2026-10-11, Sunday), 2026-10-25 has 0 (site had published nothing for that day yet). Check days: 09-30=64, 10-10=68, 10-20=52. Run time 387 s, 50 sections, ~200 requests. Sample pages 4215-10286 chars of text. CAVEAT: ledevoir.com robots.txt carries a French/English notice that content is not licensed for LLM/ML/AI use (droits@ledevoir.com). It is a comment, not a robots directive, and our UA is not in the blocked-bot list, so the fetch is permitted; flagged for whoever decides licensing.
